task.pr_title: fix: Do no aggregate results for CSV downloads from AG Grid raw records table

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
Why are we adding a group by when `metrics=[]`? Shouldn't we fix that instead?

If we don't want to change it because we're worried we're going to break something, can we at least have `metrics=null` here, instead of `undefined`? Relying on a variable being `undefined` and having to do extra work to not define it is such a brittle flow...

evidence.thread_resolution: Vitor-Avila: Good call! I've updated the logic to fix the issue at the backend level
